newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-FREE STATE DRAW WITH GRIQUAS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FREE STATE DRAW WITH GRIQUAS.

text.p: A last minute penalty from Free State flyhalf MJ Smith gave his side a 28-28 (halftime 14-12) draw with Griqualand West in their Currie Cup match in Kimberley on Saturday.
The lead changed hands six times in a see-sawing match in which neither side ever led by more than five points.

Griquas fly-half Franco Smith kicked 23 points for his side who profited from missed kicks by Free State fly-half Smith, brother of Franco, who could manage only six from 11 to his brother's eight from nine.

However MJ Smith did have the final say kicking a straight- forward penalty in the final minute to level the scores although Griquas Abrie Pretorius almost produced a match-winning drop goal in injury time.
Free State scored two tries through flanker Andre Venter and scrumhalf Werner Swanepoel who both exploited Griquas hesitancy.

Griquas were awarded a penalty try when Free State fullback Jorrie Kruger failed to release the ball when he was tackled which had put Griquas ahead for the third time, 22-19, going into the final quarter.
Griqualand West - Penalty try. Conversion: Franco Smith. Penalties: Franco Smith (7).
Free State - Tries: Andre Venter, Werner Swanepoel. Penalties: MJ Smith (6).
